points.description: States the situation: a canal fall is provided when the natural ground slope is steeper than the designed slope of the canal. Equivalent wording earns the mark, e.g. 'when the ground falls more steeply than the canal bed', 'when the natural slope exceeds the canal slope'. The comparison must run this way round. A reversed comparison (canal slope steeper than ground) earns no marks.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the student says the ground is steep or the ground level drops sharply but does not compare it with the canal's designed slope. Award 0 for a reversed comparison or a vague answer such as 'when the land is uneven'.
